title: 0xDriver: Scenario Studio For Minimal-Shot Driving Evaluation
thesis: 0xDriver contributes a randomized OOD scenario-generation and evidence-management harness for testing frozen reasoning VLAs on weird but plausible driving cases without fine-tuning.

evidence_rows.claim: We can author randomized minimal-shot driving cases from short briefs.
evidence_rows.why_it_matters: 10 prompts generated 20 candidate cases with curation rows.
evidence_rows.claim_boundary: deterministic prompt compiler; live LLM/Meshy generation is not claimed.

evidence_rows.claim: We have a judge-visible CARLA OOD video for the generated simulator path.
evidence_rows.claim_boundary: scripted simulator evidence; not an official Fail2Drive route score.

evidence_rows.claim: Frozen Alpamayo can be evaluated with and without retrieved memory on OOD cases.
evidence_rows.claim_boundary: open-loop trajectory-intent evaluation; not closed-loop VLA steering.

evidence_rows.claim: DriverX generated cases extend Fail2Drive-style OOD families.
evidence_rows.why_it_matters: 26 generated cases linked to 4 references and 2 memory entries.
evidence_rows.claim_boundary: reference layer only; official Fail2Drive score is false.

evidence_rows.claim: The final submission scope is selected and auditable.
evidence_rows.why_it_matters: 6 cases are role-classified for the submission.
evidence_rows.claim_boundary: selection matrix is planning/evidence management, not runtime execution.

video_script.visual: Title over CARLA hero video and scenario tags.
video_script.narration: The submission asks whether autonomy can handle new long-tail scenes without collecting a bespoke dataset for every corner case.
Scenario Studio turns 10 human briefs into 20 deterministic OOD candidates with assets, behaviors, memory queries, and curation gates.
The hero CARLA run is 84.0 seconds and demonstrates the generated OOD simulator path.
Frozen Alpamayo was evaluated on 3 OOD cases with memory; 2 cases changed reasoning and all remain explicitly open-loop.
DriverX links 26 generated cases to Fail2Drive-style families while avoiding an official-score claim.
The final matrix contains 6 judge-facing cases; the contribution is the generator plus evidence flywheel, not a production AV stack.

two_page_writeup.motivation: If autonomy depends on collecting examples of every weird road situation, it will always lag reality. 0xDriver reframes minimal-shot driving as a stress-test and memory problem: generate plausible OOD cases, run frozen policies through them, and preserve failures as reusable context.
two_page_writeup.architecture: The system has a Scenario Studio compiler, deterministic environment and behavior generators, CARLA/Fail2Drive-compatible evidence paths, a failure-memory bank, and an Alpamayo open-loop evaluation harness. Scenario Studio emits the curation queue; CARLA produces video and tracks; Alpamayo is evaluated with and without retrieved memory; final reports keep claim boundaries explicit.
two_page_writeup.what_worked: The final sprint generated 20 OOD candidates from 10 briefs, selected 6 judge-facing cases, linked 26 cases to Fail2Drive references, and summarized 3 Frozen Alpamayo+memory comparisons. The hero video evidence is 84.0 seconds.
two_page_writeup.what_did_not_work: The model evidence is open-loop and slow, not real-time closed-loop control. Full official Fail2Drive scoring remains a future runtime task. model_and_data_declarations: Base model: nvidia/Alpamayo-1.5-10B, used as a frozen non-commercial research model.
No AV fine-tuning is performed for these generated scenarios.
Alpamayo batch status: passed; open-loop only.
Fail2Drive reference sources: ['fixture_result', 'fixture_seed']; official score claim is false.
Model weights, datasets, videos, credentials, CARLA installs, and remote caches are excluded from git.
claim_boundaries: Alpamayo evidence is open-loop trajectory-intent and reasoning evaluation, not closed-loop car control.
Fail2Drive linkage is a benchmark reference layer, not an official leaderboard score.
Generated candidates marked accept_partial still need live CARLA/model evidence before becoming accepted dataset rows.
Hero video is generated simulator evidence and may be shown in the final demo.
Scenario Studio is deterministic unless a future provider-backed generator is explicitly configured.
